back: A program called a profiler can be used to see how long various parts of the program are taking to run, and which are impacting overall performance.
source_prefix: Introduction to optimizationIn programming, optimization is the process of modifying software to make it work more efficiently (e.g. to run faster, or use fewer resources). Optimization can have a huge impact on the overall performance level of an application.Some types of optimization are typically done by hand.
source_suffix: The programmer can then look for ways to alleviate those performance issues. Because hand-optimization is slow, programmers typically focuses on making high-level improvements that will have a large impact (such as choosing more performant algorithms, optimizing data storage and access, reducing resource utilization, parallelizing tasks, etc…)Other kinds of optimization can be performed automatically.
